command_templates.when: When a specific hive needs to be repaired.

command_templates.name: repair_directory
command_templates.when: When multiple hives in a directory need to be repaired.

usage_description: RLA is used for repairing dirty Windows Registry hives by replaying transaction logs, ensuring all possible data within the hive is parsed.

suspicious_indicators.pattern: Hive marked as dirty with transaction logs present.
